name: Stormbound Corsair
tagline: The sea's wrath rides in every cannonball.
prompt: A pirate captain who fights with cannon fire and the sea

skills.name: Broadside
skills.description: Launches a cannonball that burns along the line, exploding on impact.

skills.name: Cannon Squall
skills.description: A storm of cannonballs that erupts in a deadly whirlwind, hitting enemies for four seconds.

skills.name: Keelbreaker
skills.description: A cannonball that splits the ground, dealing damage to all enemies in a line.

skills.name: Boarding Rush
skills.description: A charge that slams through enemies, knocking them aside with a barrage of cannon fire.

skills.name: Mast Dive
skills.description: A cannonball that leaps through the air, crashing down to hit enemies.

skills.name: Captain's Bellow
skills.description: A shout that stuns enemies nearby and boosts damage for a short time.
